description: Source code for ElevenLabs speech-to-text services, including both file-based and WebSocket-based real-time transcription implementations, with support for language configuration, WebSocket management, and message handling.

classes.name: ElevenLabsSTTService
classes.description: File-based speech-to-text service integrating with ElevenLabs API, supporting language and model configuration, and transcription processing.

classes.name: ElevenLabsRealtimeSTTService
classes.description: WebSocket-based real-time speech-to-text service using ElevenLabs API, supporting VAD, language, and model configuration, with message handling and WebSocket management.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for ElevenLabs' STT API, including language and audio event tagging.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for ElevenLabs' Realtime STT WebSocket API, including language, VAD settings, and feature toggles.

classes.name: CommitStrategy
classes.description: Enum for transcript segmentation strategies: manual or VAD.

methods.name: language_to_elevenlabs_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to ElevenLabs language code string.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates support for metrics generation.

methods.name: set_language
methods.description: Sets the transcription language, requiring WebSocket reconnection for real-time service.

methods.name: set_model
methods.description: Sets the transcription model, with reconnection for real-time service.

methods.name: _transcribe_audio
methods.description: Uploads audio data to ElevenLabs API and retrieves transcription result.

methods.name: audio_format_from_sample_rate
methods.description: Returns audio format string based on sample rate.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results with tracing, implementation varies between services.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Performs transcription on provided audio bytes, yields transcription frames or errors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket connection for real-time service.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection for real-time service.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels WebSocket connection and ongoing transcription.

methods.name: start_metrics
methods.description: Starts performance metrics collection.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling speech start/stop events and triggering metrics.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to ElevenLabs Realtime STT.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Creates WebSocket connection with query parameters based on configuration.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket connection or raises error if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes WebSocket messages.

methods.name: _process_response
methods.description: Handles different message types from WebSocket, including transcripts and errors.

methods.name: _on_partial_transcript
methods.description: Handles partial (interim) transcript messages.

methods.name: _on_committed_transcript
methods.description: Handles final transcript messages.

methods.name: _on_committed_transcript_with_timestamps
methods.description: Handles final transcript with word timestamps.
